required_patterns.component-structure: All Vue components use <script setup lang="ts"> with Composition API
required_patterns.vuetify-components: UI built exclusively with Vuetify 3 components (v-container, v-card, v-btn, etc.)
required_patterns.auto-imported-components: Components in src/components/ are auto-imported without explicit import statements
required_patterns.material-design-icons: Icons use Material Design Icons with mdi- prefix

architectural_constraints.component-structure: Components must use Composition API with <script setup> syntax, no Options API
architectural_constraints.vuetify-components: All UI elements should use Vuetify components for consistency with Material Design
architectural_constraints.template-first: Components use <template> with Vuetify components, avoiding JSX/TSX
architectural_constraints.styling: Styling uses Vuetify's theming system and utility classes, custom styles in scoped <style> blocks with SCSS
architectural_constraints.responsive: Must use Vuetify's responsive grid system (v-row, v-col) and breakpoint utilities

required_patterns.file-based-routing: Routes auto-generated from src/pages/*.vue files using unplugin-vue-router
required_patterns.layout-integration: Routes integrated with layout system via setupLayouts from virtual:generated-layouts

architectural_constraints.file-based-routing: All routes must be created as .vue files in src/pages/ directory - no manual route registration
architectural_constraints.route-naming: Route paths derived from file names and directory structure in pages/
architectural_constraints.typed-routes: Router is fully typed via typed-router.d.ts, use typed route helpers
architectural_constraints.error-handling: Router includes dynamic import error handling and reload mechanism

required_patterns.store-definition: Stores defined with defineStore from auto-imported Pinia
required_patterns.options-syntax: Stores use options syntax with state, getters, actions

architectural_constraints.pinia-only: Must use Pinia for state management, no Vuex or other libraries
architectural_constraints.store-location: All stores located in src/stores/ directory
architectural_constraints.auto-import: defineStore and storeToRefs are auto-imported, no manual imports needed
architectural_constraints.typed: Stores should be fully typed with TypeScript

required_patterns.vuetify-theme: Theming configured in src/plugins/vuetify.ts with system/light/dark mode support
required_patterns.material-design: Follows Material Design principles via Vuetify components
required_patterns.mdi-icons: Material Design Icons (@mdi/font) for all iconography

architectural_constraints.vuetify-theme: Theme customization must be done through Vuetify's theme configuration or SCSS variables in settings.scss
architectural_constraints.no-custom-ui-lib: Cannot introduce other UI libraries (Bootstrap, Ant Design, etc.) - use Vuetify exclusively
architectural_constraints.consistent-spacing: Use Vuetify spacing utilities (ma-, pa-, etc.) for consistency
architectural_constraints.color-system: Use Vuetify's color system and theme variables

required_patterns.vite: Application built with Vite as build tool
required_patterns.auto-imports: Auto-import plugins for Vue APIs, components, and composables
required_patterns.hot-reload: Development with HMR via Vite dev server

architectural_constraints.vite-plugins: Configuration managed through vite.config.mts with specific plugins (VueRouter, Layouts, AutoImport, Components, Vuetify, Fonts)
architectural_constraints.typescript: Strict TypeScript usage throughout the codebase
architectural_constraints.no-manual-imports: Leverage auto-import system instead of manual imports for Vue APIs, Vuetify components, and custom components
architectural_constraints.module-resolution: Use @ alias for src/ directory imports

required_patterns.layout-structure: Layouts contain <v-main> wrapper with <router-view /> for page content
required_patterns.shared-ui: Common UI elements (headers, footers, nav) placed in layouts

architectural_constraints.default-layout: Pages use default.vue layout unless specified otherwise
architectural_constraints.v-app-structure: Root App.vue contains <v-app> wrapper for Vuetify
architectural_constraints.layout-composition: Layouts can import and use shared components like AppFooter
